svg.title: C-V2X sidelink resource allocation
svg.desc: Four V2V pairs reuse four orthogonal V2I uplink subchannels. T1 and T2 share SC 1 with U1; T3 shares SC 2 with U2; T4 shares SC 3 with U3. U4 occupies SC 4. Six directed interfering paths on SC 1 are expanded by receiver: T2 and U1 to R1, T1 and U1 to R2, and T1 and T2 to the base station. Every V2V transmitter chooses one of four subchannels and three power levels, or no transmission.
